properties.label: CORAL SHIPREP · reporting-area outer boundary
properties.areaName: Papahānaumokuākea National Marine Sanctuary
properties.sourceCitation: 15 CFR part 922, subpart W, appendix E; IMO resolution MSC.279(85)
properties.geometryNote: 15 CFR part 922, appendix E specifies an arc of 60.25 nm centered at 23°03.61′N, 161°55.22′W (Point 21) and an arc of 60.17 nm centered at 28°25.23′N, 178°19.51′W (Point 20). Each is rendered with spherical samples at 0.25° bearing intervals, joined to the regulation’s listed endpoints; those rounded endpoints do not lie exactly on the stated radii. The regulation does not specify an arc construction or sweep convention. The listed rhumb-line positions are connected as map segments. The displayed geometry is an approximate rendering of the cited source, not a legal navigation or compliance boundary.

properties.areaName: Northeastern North Atlantic right whale mandatory ship reporting area
properties.sourceCitation: 33 CFR § 169.105 (WHALESNORTH geographic boundary)
properties.geometryNote: Current 33 CFR § 169.105 gives seven ordered offshore positions in NAD 83 and closes the area along the Massachusetts shoreline of Cape Cod Bay and Massachusetts Bay. This overlay contains only those seven positions joined by straight map segments: it does not include the required shoreline closure, so it is partial and approximate, not the full boundary. WHALESNORTH is year-round; reporting applies to self-propelled ships of 300 gross tons or greater, subject to stated government-vessel exemptions. Display only—not for navigation or compliance.
properties.label: WHALESNORTH · offshore positions (shoreline closure omitted)
GDANREP · official reporting line
properties.areaName: Approaches to the Polish ports in the Gulf of Gdańsk
properties.sourceCitation: IMO resolution MSC.249(83), §§2.2.2–2.2.3; Maritime Office in Gdynia, VTS Zatoka Gdańska
properties.geometryNote: The Maritime Office in Gdynia publishes the four external boundary points of the compulsory GDANREP area. IMO resolution MSC.249(83) §2.2.2 identifies Polish chart No. 151 (INT 1291), edition 2004, and specifies WGS 84 datum; §2.2.3 defines the reporting line by these positions. The full operational area extends south of 54°45′N between this line and the Polish coastline. This feature draws only the verified open line, not an inferred area polygon. The Polish authority states that VTS reporting is obligatory for all vessels in the VTS area, GDANREP reports are required for passenger vessels, cargo vessels of 150 GT or more, and all vessels engaged in towage, while other VHF-equipped vessels may participate voluntarily. Display geometry only—not a navigation boundary.

properties.label: WHALESSOUTH · offshore limit (partial boundary)
properties.areaName: Southeastern North Atlantic right whale mandatory ship reporting area, Florida and Georgia
properties.sourceCitation: 33 CFR §§ 169.115, 169.120, 169.125 (current eCFR geographic extent, season, and vessel classes)
properties.geometryNote: Current 33 CFR § 169.115 gives NAD 83 limits from the shoreline east to 80°51.6′W, with southern and northern limits at 30°00′N and 31°27′N. This overlay draws only the offshore meridian segment; it omits both latitude limits and the shoreline closure, so it is not the full boundary. WHALESSOUTH operates 15 November through 16 April; reporting applies to self-propelled ships of 300 gross tons or greater, subject to stated government-vessel exemptions. Display only—not for navigation or compliance.

properties.label: REEFREP · published offshore boundary segments (partial)
properties.areaName: Great Barrier Reef and Torres Strait
properties.sourceCitation: Marine Order 63 (Vessel reporting systems) 2019, current, commenced 1 January 2020, §§ 4(3), 5; IMO resolution MSC.315(88), annex 14, amending MSC.52(66), annex 1 §§ 2.1–2.2
properties.datum: WGS 84 for latitude/longitude parallels and meridians under Marine Order 63 § 5; no datum stated for chart/coast/reef-edge portions
properties.geometryNote: Marine Order 63 is current and commenced 1 January 2020; § 5 specifies WGS 84 for positions of parallels and meridians. Under IMO MSC.315(88), annex 14 § 2.1, the offshore boundary continues from 21°00′S, 152°55′E to 23°42′S, 153°45′E to 24°30′S, 153°35′E, then west along 24°30′S to the Queensland low-water coastline; the coastline then runs generally northwest to Cape York latitude 10°40′S. North of that, REEFREP covers Torres Strait between 141°45′E and 144°00′E and GBR waters between Australian coast and the outer reef edge. The latter limits follow chart AUS 4620 (1996) and AUS 4635 (2010), with an annex chartlet; full chart/reef/coast geometry remains unverified, so this open offshore chain is not a complete area polygon. Display only—not for navigation or compliance.

coverageNotes.status: Partial explicit-coordinate legs in selected local Eastern VTS Zones; no complete Eastern VTS Zone GIS polygon published in reviewed sources
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: SOR/2025-275 Schedules 2 and 3; CCG RAMN 2026 Part 3
coverageNotes.datum: Not stated for coordinate descriptions or maritime limits
coverageNotes.note: The former ECAREG area was replaced on 31 March 2026 by the Eastern VTS Zone under SOR/2025-275. Schedule 2 gives the broad extent in words; Schedule 3 defines local zones with mixed coordinates, bearings, shore references and territorial-sea limits. The map shows only explicitly coordinate-to-coordinate legs/position chains for St. John’s, Halifax, Strait of Canso, Northumberland Strait and Bay of Fundy. bearing rays, shoreline sections and legs following maritime limits are omitted rather than guessed; a malformed Bay of Fundy coordinate is also omitted. The regulation states no datum. These references are not complete local-area polygons or the full Eastern VTS Zone.

coverageNotes.status: Partial statutory display lines for SSCZ 5 and 7 only; no complete Northern VTS Zone GIS polygon published in reviewed sources
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: SOR/2025-275 Schedule 4; Shipping Safety Control Zones Order, §§ 2–3, Schedule 1 and Schedule 2
coverageNotes.datum: Not stated for statutory coordinate descriptions; seaward edges follow Canada’s EEZ limit, subject to Canada–Greenland international boundary exception
coverageNotes.note: The Northern VTS Zone replaced the former NORDREG regulatory area on 31 March 2026 under SOR/2025-275 Schedule 4. The Schedule incorporates 16 Arctic Shipping Safety Control Zones and adds named bays, inlets, rivers and lakes. The map now shows full coordinate-defined outlines for SSCZ 5 and 7 only. Other SSCZ descriptions mix coordinates with shortest lines, shore segments defined by the upper limit of shore, and EEZ/Canada–Greenland seaward limits. The regulation states no geodetic datum; those shores, limits, other zones, and the complete Northern VTS Zone are not drawn. No complete Northern VTS polygon is inferred.

coverageNotes.status: 35 NM radius established in IMO MSC.52(66); domestic current status/center coordinate and datum remain unverified
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: IMO resolution MSC.52(66), annex 10 §§ 1.2–1.3; Préfecture maritime de l’Atlantique arrêté 2021-057 (version consolidée), official archive; repealed predecessor arrêté 2017-085
coverageNotes.datum: Not specified in IMO text; chart 6989 (French Navy Hydrographic and Oceanographic Department) cited
coverageNotes.note: IMO MSC.52(66) states that OUESSREP reporting begins on entering a 35 NM radius circle centred on Ile d’Ouessant (Stiff radar tower), and cites French Navy hydrographic chart 6989. The 40 NM wording found in repealed 2017-085 concerns the French coastal navigation zone, not the IMO mandatory reporting circle; the two radii refer to different operational areas. The official prefecture archive lists 2017-085 as repealed and provides consolidated arrêté 2021-057 as the current general navigation order, but the linked scan could not be text-verified here. Neither the exact radar-tower coordinate/datum nor an authoritative current georeferenced circle center has been confirmed; no circle is drawn.

coverageNotes.status: Published WGS 84 coordinate chains from MSC.190(79) shown as partial open lines; coast/chart intersections and full perimeter omitted; MSC.301(87) boundary amendment check completed.
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: IMO resolutions MSC.190(79), Annex 1 §2.1, and MSC.301(87), §§1–3
coverageNotes.note: MSC.190(79) §2.1 lists numbered positions and references Admiralty Chart 4011 (WGS 84). MSC.301(87) was checked against the original: its amendments add the Portugal VTS and replace service contact details, but do not amend §2.1 coordinates. The plotted coordinate chains remain partial; coast/chart-intersection positions are not reconstructed and no polygon is inferred. WETREP applies to specified oil tankers over 600 tonnes DWT carrying listed heavy oils.

coverageNotes.status: Four offshore coordinates encoded as an open partial chain; no polygon closure.
coverageNotes.note: Adopted 1 Dec 2008. Accessible text gives offshore chain and coast limits, but operative annex, datum, classes and shoreline closure not fully verified; no polygon drawn.

coverageNotes.status: Published north/south coordinate runs shown as partial overlays; MSC.332(90)/Rev.1 adopted 22 May 2026 and will take effect 1 December 2026.
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: IMO resolutions MSC.332(90) and MSC.332(90)/Rev.1; Danish Armed Forces BELTREP guidance
coverageNotes.note: MSC.332(90)/Rev.1 was adopted on 22 May 2026 and will be implemented at 0000 UTC on 1 December 2026, when it revokes MSC.332(90); the original resolution remains operative on this verification date. Both resolutions specify WGS 84 and publish report/borderline positions, but the plotted runs do not reconstruct chartlet/coast edges or the complete operational area. Operator guidance: ≥50 GT or air draught ≥15 m, with pleasure-craft exemptions.

coverageNotes.status: IMO international-waters perimeter, published numeric reporting-line segments, and Finnish/Tallinn national VTS limit segments encoded; named endpoints and full national-area polygons remain incomplete.
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: IMO MSC.231(82); Fintraffic GOFREP Master’s Guide, section 4
coverageNotes.note: The closed coordinate line is only the IMO international-waters boundary. Fintraffic publishes WGS 84 western, central, eastern, St. Petersburg–Tallinn and Väinameri reporting lines, plus Finnish and Tallinn national VTS outer-limit positions. Only the numeric-coordinate portion of the western line is drawn; its named lighthouse and peninsula endpoints are omitted. Reporting divisions and open national VTS segments are not complete national mandatory-area perimeters. Display only—not navigation or compliance.

coverageNotes.status: Four-position reporting line only; area shoreline closure omitted
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: IMO resolution MSC.249(83), §§2.2.2–2.2.3; Maritime Office in Gdynia
coverageNotes.note: The Maritime Office in Gdynia publishes the four line positions. IMO resolution MSC.249(83) specifies Polish chart No. 151 (INT 1291), edition 2004, WGS 84 datum, and defines the open reporting line. The legal area lies south of 54°45′N between the line and Polish coastline; only the open line is plotted.

coverageNotes.status: Offshore coordinate chain verified; chartlet/reef/coast perimeter remains incomplete
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: Marine Order 63 (Vessel reporting systems) 2019 §§ 4(3), 5; IMO MSC.315(88), annex 14, amending MSC.52(66), annex 1 §§ 2.1–2.2
coverageNotes.datum: WGS 84 for statutory latitude/longitude; no datum specified for chart/reef/coast portions
coverageNotes.note: Primary IMO annex text confirms exact offshore chain (21°00′S 152°55′E → 23°42′S 153°45′E → 24°30′S 153°35′E), then west on 24°30′S to Queensland low-water coastline and generally northwest along coast to Cape York latitude 10°40′S. Torres Strait limits are 141°45′E–144°00′E; GBR waters run between coast and outer reef edge. IMO annex identifies chartlet appendix 1 and charts AUS 4620 (1996) and AUS 4635 (2010); chartlet/reef edge/coastline not yet georeferenced. Marine Order 63 § 5 expressly gives WGS 84 for parallels/meridians. Internal 18°S North/South operations division is not an outer reporting boundary. No complete polygon is drawn.

coverageNotes.status: Operative WGS 84 report/border lines; Rev.1 adopted 22 May 2026, with the same listed line coordinates, will be implemented 1 December 2026; no area polygon.
coverageNotes.note: MSC.314(88)/Rev.1 was adopted 22 May 2026 and will be implemented at 0000 UTC on 1 December 2026, when it revokes MSC.314(88). The Rev.1 report/border-line positions match the currently operative resolution; the five features remain open segments, not a closed area. Mandatory class 300 GT and upwards, subject to exceptions.
Four points are connected and closed as stated. Datum not stated; display only, not navigation or compliance.

coverageNotes.status: Offshore positions plotted; Massachusetts shoreline omitted
coverageNotes.note: Year-round; self-propelled ships ≥300 GT subject to exceptions. Regulation closes along Massachusetts shoreline; plotted feature is partial.

coverageNotes.status: Offshore meridian only; parallels and coast omitted
coverageNotes.note: Season 15 Nov–16 Apr; area spans 30°00′N–31°27′N from coast to 80°51.6′W. Current feature only draws offshore meridian.

coverageNotes.status: Report-trigger line only; chart-defined nine-sector area not polygonized
coverageNotes.note: System area is chart-defined between 100°40′E and 104°23′E, with nine sectors. Tg Piai–Karimun Kecil is a reporting line, not outer boundary.

coverageNotes.status: Federal perimeter and four ATBA lines plotted; sampled arcs approximate
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: 15 CFR Part 922 Subpart W Appendix E; IMO MSC.279(85)
coverageNotes.note: Current boundary source is Title 15 CFR Appendix E; 50 CFR Appendix E is report syntax, not boundary. Arc construction is not fully specified; rendered arcs are approximate.

coverageNotes.status: Voluntary global reporting/SAR service; not a mandatory area
coverageNotes.sourceCitation: CCG RAMN 2026 Part 4; U.S. Coast Guard AMVER
coverageNotes.note: AMVER is a voluntary global program, not a mandatory geographically bounded reporting system; no map boundary is appropriate.

coverageNotes.status: SOLAS global identification/tracking regime; not an area-entry system
coverageNotes.note: LRIT is ship identification and tracking, not a geographic area-entry reporting system; no area overlay is appropriate.
